propositions: Jira rebar-id label is written before local CREATE event and binding are durably published, creating a crash window where ephemeral runner push rejection leaves label persisted but local state lost

Existing healing paths stand down when rebar-id label is present (binding_walk L10 guard, differ bug-4354 suppression, BindingRecovery.recover_pending_bindings), leaving permanently stuck unbound_jira drift requiring manual repair

Recovery extension detects marked-but-unstored keys where rebar-id label equals deterministic inbound local id with no binding-store entry and no local ticket, replaying adopt through existing inbound-create leaf instead of standing down

Idempotent replay routed through existing _apply_inbound_create leaf re-materializes local ticket and binding under same deterministic local id with no duplicate label, converging all replays on same identity
